titel: We welcome the arrival of fall with our coziest guests!

einzeiler: A cozy autumn-themed compilation featuring Sally Field, Robert Smigel, and more.
kurzfassung: This special autumn-themed episode revisits favorite comedic interviews and segments from the past year. Host Nagin Farsad and announcer Alzo Slade present conversations with actor Sally Field, comedy writer Robert Smigel, author Carol Claire Burke, and musician Jason Narducci. The show also includes classic quiz games and listener bluff segments.
stichpunkte: Nagin Farsad hosts the autumn-themed news quiz in place of Peter Sagal.
Actor Sally Field discusses her career, her role in Remarkably Bright Creatures, and playing The Flying Nun.
Robert Smigel talks about his father's legacy as a dentist and creating Triumph the Insult Comic Dog.
Author Carol Claire Burke shares the journey behind her bestselling novel Yesteryear.
Musician Jason Narducci reflects on starting a punk band at age eleven and touring with Michael Shannon.
Panelists present fabricated news stories in the Bluff the Listener segment.

clips.text: The guest explains that performing aerial stunts on an older television program involved wearing a harness attached to wires while being suspended from a crane.

clips.hook: The strange journey of Wally the alligator
clips.text: Following an abduction from its enclosure, an emotional support alligator was recovered by wildlife authorities and returned to a natural swamp habitat.

clips.hook: Fascism forever in the high school yearbook
clips.text: Scrutiny arose over a Supreme Court nominee's past when it was discovered he jokingly included a reference to a fictitious extremist club in his graduation photo page.
A panelist jokingly claims that the star of a famous 1980s music video launched an adult content platform using artificial intelligence to maintain her animated aesthetic.

clips.hook: Playing a famous venue at age eleven
clips.text: The guest recounts playing a concert at a prominent Chicago music venue as a pre-teen while his father recorded the performance on a heavy vintage camcorder.

beschreibung:
This week, guest host Negin Farsad helps us celebrate fall with some of our favorite guests, including Sally Field, Robert Smigel, Caro Claire Burke, and Jason Narducy.
